items.title: 在职群体参加继续学习的目的
items.en: purposes of continuing education among employees

blocks.v: The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the purposes of continuing education among working people are distributed. Improving current job skills takes the lead, accounting for 65%, followed by learning about new fields and developing personal interests at 48% and 37% respectively, while obtaining qualifications comes last at 26%. Taken together, the three largest items make up 150%.

sents.en: The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the purposes of continuing education among working people are distributed.
sents.cn: 该柱状图清晰地展示了在职群体参加继续教育的目的分布情况。

sents.en: Improving current job skills takes the lead, accounting for 65%, followed by learning about new fields and developing personal interests at 48% and 37% respectively, while obtaining qualifications comes last at 26%.
sents.cn: 提升现有岗位技能遥遥领先，占 65%；其后是学习新领域和发展个人兴趣，分别占 48% 和 37%；而获得文凭位居最后，占 26%。

sents.en: Taken together, the three largest items make up 150%.
sents.cn: 前三项加起来占 150%。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, technology changes so fast that skills learned at school go out of date within a few years. Equally important, employers now look at what a person can actually do rather than at diplomas alone. Beyond that, working adults have found that learning a new field keeps a career from stalling.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, technology changes so fast that skills learned at school go out of date within a few years.
sents.cn: 首先，技术更新极快，学校里学到的技能几年之内就会过时。

sents.en: Equally important, employers now look at what a person can actually do rather than at diplomas alone.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，用人单位如今更看重一个人实际能做什么，而不只是文凭。

sents.en: Beyond that, working adults have found that learning a new field keeps a career from stalling.
sents.cn: 此外，职场人也发现，学习一个新领域能让职业发展不至于停滞。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Government can fund evening schools and open online courses so that learning does not depend on income. Employers should set aside a few paid hours each month for staff training. Individuals need to choose courses that fit their stage of career rather than follow the crowd. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Government can fund evening schools and open online courses so that learning does not depend on income.
sents.cn: 政府可以资助夜校和免费的网络课程，让学习不再取决于收入。

sents.en: Employers should set aside a few paid hours each month for staff training.
sents.cn: 用人单位应每月留出几个带薪小时用于员工培训。

sents.en: Individuals need to choose courses that fit their stage of career rather than follow the crowd.
sents.cn: 个人则应根据自己所处的职业阶段选课，而不是随大流。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分理由相信，这一趋势在未来几年仍会延续。

items.title: 燃油车与新能源汽车国内销量
items.en: domestic sales of fuel and new energy vehicles

blocks.v: The line chart above clearly illustrates the changes in domestic sales of conventional and new energy vehicles from January to June 2025. Sales of new energy vehicles rose from 0.79 million to 1.12 million, while the figure for conventional vehicles fluctuated and peaked at 1.33 million in March. The two moved in the same direction, but not at the same pace.

sents.en: The line chart above clearly illustrates the changes in domestic sales of conventional and new energy vehicles from January to June 2025.
sents.cn: 该折线图清晰地展示了 2025 年 1 月至 6 月燃油车与新能源汽车国内销量的变化。

sents.en: Sales of new energy vehicles rose from 0.79 million to 1.12 million, while the figure for conventional vehicles fluctuated and peaked at 1.33 million in March.
sents.cn: 新能源汽车销量从 79 万辆增至 112 万辆，而燃油车销量则起伏波动，在 3 月达到 133 万辆的峰值。

sents.en: The two moved in the same direction, but not at the same pace.
sents.cn: 两者方向一致，但速度不同。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, growing concern about air quality has made low-emission travel a matter of personal responsibility. Equally important, charging an electric car costs far less than filling a petrol tank every week. Beyond that, more charging points and more models have removed the worries that once held buyers back.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, growing concern about air quality has made low-emission travel a matter of personal responsibility.
sents.cn: 首先，人们对空气质量的关注不断增强，使低排放出行成为一种个人责任。

sents.en: Equally important, charging an electric car costs far less than filling a petrol tank every week.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，给电动车充电的花费远低于每周加满一箱油。

sents.en: Beyond that, more charging points and more models have removed the worries that once held buyers back.
sents.cn: 此外，充电桩和车型不断增多，打消了曾经让消费者犹豫的顾虑。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Car makers should keep improving batteries so that one charge covers a longer distance. Government can speed up the building of charging points in older neighbourhoods. Individuals should pick a model that suits their daily travel rather than follow the crowd. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Car makers should keep improving batteries so that one charge covers a longer distance.
sents.cn: 车企应持续改进电池，让一次充电能跑更远的距离。

sents.en: Government can speed up the building of charging points in older neighbourhoods.
sents.cn: 政府可以加快老旧小区充电桩的建设。

sents.en: Individuals should pick a model that suits their daily travel rather than follow the crowd.
sents.cn: 个人应根据自己的日常出行需求选车，而不是跟风。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分理由相信，这一趋势在未来几年仍会延续。

items.title: 居民日常出行选择
items.en: residents' daily travel choices

blocks.v: The chart above clearly illustrates the changes in daily transport choices in a city from 2015 to 2021. The proportion of residents choosing buses fell from just over 50% to under 30%, while the shares for ride-hailing services and shared bicycles rose to approximately a quarter each. The two moved in opposite directions.

sents.en: The chart above clearly illustrates the changes in daily transport choices in a city from 2015 to 2021.
sents.cn: 该图清晰地展示了 2015 年至 2021 年某市居民日常出行方式的变化。

sents.en: The proportion of residents choosing buses fell from just over 50% to under 30%, while the shares for ride-hailing services and shared bicycles rose to approximately a quarter each.
sents.cn: 选择公交的居民比例从略高于 50% 降至不足 30%，而网约车和共享单车的占比各自升至约四分之一。

sents.en: The two moved in opposite directions.
sents.cn: 两者朝相反的方向变化。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, mobile payment and map apps have turned hailing a car into a matter of a few taps. Equally important, shared bicycles cover the last kilometre that buses never quite reach. Beyond that, fixed routes and long waits have made the bus a less attractive choice.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, mobile payment and map apps have turned hailing a car into a matter of a few taps.
sents.cn: 首先，移动支付和地图应用让打车变成点几下手机的事。

sents.en: Equally important, shared bicycles cover the last kilometre that buses never quite reach.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，共享单车填补了公交始终难以覆盖的最后一公里。

sents.en: Beyond that, fixed routes and long waits have made the bus a less attractive choice.
sents.cn: 此外，固定线路和长时间等车让公交的吸引力明显下降。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Government can redraw bus routes and add bus lanes so that public transport saves real time. Platforms should keep prices clear and stop bicycles from blocking pavements. Residents can cycle for short trips and take the bus for longer ones. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Government can redraw bus routes and add bus lanes so that public transport saves real time.
sents.cn: 政府可以重划公交线路、增设公交专用道，让公共交通真正省时。

sents.en: Platforms should keep prices clear and stop bicycles from blocking pavements.
sents.cn: 平台应保持价格透明，并避免共享单车堵塞人行道。

sents.en: Residents can cycle for short trips and take the bus for longer ones.
sents.cn: 居民短途可以骑车，长途则选择公交。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分理由相信，这一趋势在未来几年仍会延续。

items.title: 大学生择业考虑因素
items.en: factors in college students' career choices

blocks.v: The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the factors considered by university students when choosing a job are distributed. Personal development prospects take the lead, accounting for 65%, followed by pay and company reputation at 53% and 31% respectively, while personal interests and the working environment come last at 22% and 9%. The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide.

sents.en: The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the factors considered by university students when choosing a job are distributed.
sents.cn: 该柱状图清晰地展示了大学生择业时考虑的各项因素的分布情况。

sents.en: Personal development prospects take the lead, accounting for 65%, followed by pay and company reputation at 53% and 31% respectively, while personal interests and the working environment come last at 22% and 9%.
sents.cn: 个人发展前景遥遥领先，占 65%；其后是薪酬和公司声誉，分别占 53% 和 31%；而个人兴趣和工作环境位居最后，占 22% 和 9%。

sents.en: The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide.
sents.cn: 最大项与最小项之间差距很大。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, young people now value room to grow more than a post they can hold for decades. Equally important, the cost of living in big cities keeps pay near the top of the list. Beyond that, recruitment sites and former employees have made company reputation easier to check.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, young people now value room to grow more than a post they can hold for decades.
sents.cn: 首先，如今年轻人更看重成长空间，而不是一份能守上几十年的岗位。

sents.en: Equally important, the cost of living in big cities keeps pay near the top of the list.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，大城市的生活成本使薪酬依然排在前列。

sents.en: Beyond that, recruitment sites and former employees have made company reputation easier to check.
sents.cn: 此外，招聘网站和离职员工的评价让公司声誉更容易查证。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Universities should offer career courses that help students compare offers in a clear framework. Employers should spell out promotion paths instead of promising vague opportunities. Students need to weigh their own strengths before following a popular choice. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Universities should offer career courses that help students compare offers in a clear framework.
sents.cn: 高校应开设职业课程，帮助学生用清晰的框架比较不同选择。

sents.en: Employers should spell out promotion paths instead of promising vague opportunities.
sents.cn: 用人单位应明确写出晋升路径，而不是给出模糊的机会承诺。

sents.en: Students need to weigh their own strengths before following a popular choice.
sents.cn: 学生则应在跟从热门选择之前，先衡量自己的优势。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分理由相信，这一趋势在未来几年仍会延续。

items.title: 全国便利店门店数量
items.en: the number of convenience stores nationwide

blocks.v: The line chart above clearly illustrates the growth in the number of convenience stores in China from 2015 to 2023. The total rose from roughly 90,000 to approximately 320,000, and the first half of the period saw a steady rise while the last few years brought a sharp acceleration. The figure more than doubled over the period.

sents.en: The line chart above clearly illustrates the growth in the number of convenience stores in China from 2015 to 2023.
sents.cn: 该折线图清晰地展示了 2015 年至 2023 年全国便利店门店数量的增长。

sents.en: The total rose from roughly 90,000 to approximately 320,000, and the first half of the period saw a steady rise while the last few years brought a sharp acceleration.
sents.cn: 门店总数从约 9 万家增至约 32 万家；前半段稳步上升，最后几年明显加速。

sents.en: The figure more than doubled over the period.
sents.cn: 这一数字在该时期翻了一倍多。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, long working hours have left city dwellers little time for large supermarkets. Equally important, round-the-clock opening hours match the irregular schedules of shift workers. Beyond that, chains have moved into smaller cities, where such stores were once rare.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, long working hours have left city dwellers little time for large supermarkets.
sents.cn: 首先，漫长的工时让城市居民几乎没有时间逛大型超市。

sents.en: Equally important, round-the-clock opening hours match the irregular schedules of shift workers.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，二十四小时营业契合了倒班人群不规律的作息。

sents.en: Beyond that, chains have moved into smaller cities, where such stores were once rare.
sents.cn: 此外，连锁品牌不断进入小城市，这类门店过去在那里并不多见。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Chains should keep food fresh and treat their staff fairly while they expand. Government can tighten checks on food safety and on how these stores are run. Individuals should buy only what they need instead of stocking up on discounts. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Chains should keep food fresh and treat their staff fairly while they expand.
sents.cn: 连锁企业在扩张的同时，应保证食品新鲜、善待员工。

sents.en: Government can tighten checks on food safety and on how these stores are run.
sents.cn: 政府可以加强对食品安全和门店经营的检查。

sents.en: Individuals should buy only what they need instead of stocking up on discounts.
sents.cn: 个人应按需购买，而不是一见打折就囤货。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分理由相信，这一趋势在未来几年仍会延续。

blocks.v: This meeting was for the purpose of discussing food waste in daily life, and all participants finally came to the same conclusion.

items.title: 公共场所无障碍通道的普及
items.en: barrier-free passages in public places

notes.zh: 2021~2025 年某市公共场所设置无障碍通道的比例
notes.en: the share of public places with barrier-free passages in a city, 2021–2025

notes.zh: 注：无障碍通道指坡道、升降设施等便于行动不便者进出的通道
notes.en: Barrier-free passages refer to ramps, lifts and other facilities that help people with mobility difficulties get in and out.

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts a wheelchair user approaching a public building by an accessible route, while the chart illustrates improvements in accessibility. The proportion of public places with accessible routes in a city rose steadily from 56% in 2021 to 85% in 2025. Together, the two images highlight progress toward a more inclusive society.

sents.en: The cartoon above depicts a wheelchair user approaching a public building by an accessible route, while the chart illustrates improvements in accessibility.
sents.cn: 上图描绘了一名轮椅使用者沿无障碍通道走向一栋公共建筑，而旁边的图表则显示了无障碍环境的改善。

sents.en: The proportion of public places with accessible routes in a city rose steadily from 56% in 2021 to 85% in 2025.
sents.cn: 某市配备无障碍通道的公共场所比例从 2021 年的 56% 稳步升至 2025 年的 85%。

sents.en: Together, the two images highlight progress toward a more inclusive society.
sents.cn: 两幅材料共同凸显了社会走向包容的进步。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, new regulations require public buildings to provide step-free access. Equally important, an ageing population has made accessibility a concern for ordinary families. Beyond that, wider public attention has pushed many venues to improve their facilities on their own.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, new regulations require public buildings to provide step-free access.
sents.cn: 首先，新的法规要求公共建筑提供无障碍通行条件。

sents.en: Equally important, an ageing population has made accessibility a concern for ordinary families.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，人口老龄化让无障碍成为普通家庭也会关心的问题。

sents.en: Beyond that, wider public attention has pushed many venues to improve their facilities on their own.
sents.cn: 此外，公众关注度提高，也促使不少场所主动改善自身的设施。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Government should check that ramps and lifts actually work instead of counting them on paper. Venues should keep accessible routes clear of bicycles and goods. Individuals can speak up when they see a barrier blocking someone else. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Government should check that ramps and lifts actually work instead of counting them on paper.
sents.cn: 政府应检查坡道和电梯是否真正可用，而不是只在纸面上统计数量。

sents.en: Venues should keep accessible routes clear of bicycles and goods.
sents.cn: 各类场所应保持无障碍通道不被自行车和货物占用。

sents.en: Individuals can speak up when they see a barrier blocking someone else.
sents.cn: 个人在看到障碍物挡住他人通行时，也可以主动反映。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分理由相信，这一趋势在未来几年仍会延续。

items.title: 急救知识的普及
items.en: the popularisation of first-aid knowledge

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts a person teaching others a basic first-aid skill, while the chart illustrates growing participation in first-aid training. In a city, the proportion of residents aged 18 to 60 who received such training increased steadily from 9% in 2021 to 32% in 2025. These materials highlight the spread of practical knowledge of emergency response.

sents.en: The cartoon above depicts a person teaching others a basic first-aid skill, while the chart illustrates growing participation in first-aid training.
sents.cn: 上图描绘了一个人向他人传授基本急救技能，下图则展示了急救培训参与度的提升。

sents.en: In a city, the proportion of residents aged 18 to 60 who received such training increased steadily from 9% in 2021 to 32% in 2025.
sents.cn: 某市 18 至 60 岁居民中接受过此类培训的比例，从 2021 年的 9% 稳步升至 2025 年的 32%。

sents.en: These materials highlight the spread of practical knowledge of emergency response.
sents.cn: 这些材料凸显了应急处置实用知识的普及。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, first-aid courses have been brought into schools and neighbourhoods. Equally important, reports of accidents have shown people how much a few minutes can matter. Beyond that, short online lessons make training far easier to fit into a busy week.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, first-aid courses have been brought into schools and neighbourhoods.
sents.cn: 首先，急救课程已经进入学校和社区。

sents.en: Equally important, reports of accidents have shown people how much a few minutes can matter.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，事故报道让人们看到短短几分钟有多关键。

sents.en: Beyond that, short online lessons make training far easier to fit into a busy week.
sents.cn: 此外，简短的线上课程让培训更容易安排进忙碌的一周。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Government can make first aid a required part of the school curriculum. Communities should hold practice sessions so that the skills are not forgotten. Individuals can learn basic CPR before they actually need it. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Government can make first aid a required part of the school curriculum.
sents.cn: 政府可以把急救纳入学校的必修内容。

sents.en: Communities should hold practice sessions so that the skills are not forgotten.
sents.cn: 社区应定期组织演练，让这些技能不至于遗忘。

sents.en: Individuals can learn basic CPR before they actually need it.
sents.cn: 个人可以在真正需要之前学会基本的心肺复苏。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分理由相信，这一趋势在未来几年仍会延续。

items.title: 留学人员回国发展
items.en: overseas returnees developing their careers at home

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts overseas students returning to China, while the chart below illustrates the growth in their numbers. The annual number of returning students increased from 134,800 in 2010 to 600,000 in 2019, rising to more than four times its initial level. Together, the materials highlight the growing appeal of returning home after studying abroad.

sents.en: The cartoon above depicts overseas students returning to China, while the chart below illustrates the growth in their numbers.
sents.cn: 上图描绘了留学人员回国，下图则展示了回国人数的增长。

sents.en: The annual number of returning students increased from 134,800 in 2010 to 600,000 in 2019, rising to more than four times its initial level.
sents.cn: 年度回国人数从 2010 年的 13.48 万增至 2019 年的 60 万，达到最初水平的四倍多。

sents.en: Together, the materials highlight the growing appeal of returning home after studying abroad.
sents.cn: 两则材料共同凸显了留学后回国发展的吸引力日益增强。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, China now offers research and business opportunities that once existed only abroad. Equally important, being close to parents matters more as they grow older. Beyond that, local governments have eased household registration and funding for start-ups.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, China now offers research and business opportunities that once existed only abroad.
sents.cn: 首先，国内如今提供了过去只在海外才有的科研与创业机会。

sents.en: Equally important, being close to parents matters more as they grow older.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，父母年纪渐长，留在身边变得愈发重要。

sents.en: Beyond that, local governments have eased household registration and funding for start-ups.
sents.cn: 此外，地方政府在落户和创业资金方面放宽了条件。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Government can shorten paperwork for returnees who start companies or join research labs. Universities and firms should create posts that let returnees use what they learned abroad. Returnees need to adapt to local ways of working instead of expecting them to change. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Government can shorten paperwork for returnees who start companies or join research labs.
sents.cn: 政府可以简化回国人员创业、进入实验室的办事流程。

sents.en: Universities and firms should create posts that let returnees use what they learned abroad.
sents.cn: 高校和企业应设置岗位，让回国人员用上海外所学。

sents.en: Returnees need to adapt to local ways of working instead of expecting them to change.
sents.cn: 回国人员则需要适应本地的工作方式，而不是期待它为自己改变。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分理由相信，这一趋势在未来几年仍会延续。

items.title: 中国人平均寿命与人口老龄化
items.en: average life expectancy and population ageing

blocks.v: The charts above illustrate changes in life expectancy and population aging in China. Average life expectancy rose from 72.54 years in 2004 to 79 years in 2024. Meanwhile, the proportion of people aged 60 and above increased from 10.97% to 22%, slightly more than doubling. Taken together, the two trends describe a society that lives longer and grows older at the same time.

sents.en: The charts above illustrate changes in life expectancy and population aging in China.
sents.cn: 以上两幅图展示了中国人均预期寿命与人口老龄化的变化。

sents.en: Average life expectancy rose from 72.54 years in 2004 to 79 years in 2024.
sents.cn: 人均预期寿命从 2004 年的 72.54 岁升至 2024 年的 79 岁。

sents.en: Meanwhile, the proportion of people aged 60 and above increased from 10.97% to 22%, slightly more than doubling.
sents.cn: 与此同时，60 岁及以上人口比例从 10.97% 升至 22%，略高于翻倍。

sents.en: Taken together, the two trends describe a society that lives longer and grows older at the same time.
sents.cn: 综合来看，这两组趋势所描述的，是一个寿命更长、同时老得更快的社会。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, better hospitals and wider medical insurance have pushed life expectancy steadily upward. Equally important, improved nutrition and sanitation have cut deaths from infectious disease. Beyond that, a falling birth rate has made the share of older people rise even faster.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, better hospitals and wider medical insurance have pushed life expectancy steadily upward.
sents.cn: 首先，更好的医院和更广的医保覆盖推动人均寿命稳步上升。

sents.en: Equally important, improved nutrition and sanitation have cut deaths from infectious disease.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，营养与卫生条件改善，使传染病导致的死亡大幅减少。

sents.en: Beyond that, a falling birth rate has made the share of older people rise even faster.
sents.cn: 此外，出生率持续走低，使老年人口的占比上升得更快。

blocks.v: On balance, the figures point to a problem worth taking seriously. Government should expand community clinics and affordable care for older people. Companies can design products and services that suit older customers. Families need to share care duties instead of leaving them to one member. Unless effective measures are taken, it may well get worse.

sents.en: On balance, the figures point to a problem worth taking seriously.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这些数据指向一个不容忽视的问题。

sents.en: Government should expand community clinics and affordable care for older people.
sents.cn: 政府应扩大社区诊所和面向老年人的平价照护。

sents.en: Companies can design products and services that suit older customers.
sents.cn: 企业可以设计适合老年客户的产品与服务。

sents.en: Families need to share care duties instead of leaving them to one member.
sents.cn: 家庭成员应分担照护责任，而不是全压在一个人身上。

sents.en: Unless effective measures are taken, it may well get worse.
sents.cn: 若不采取有效措施，情况很可能进一步恶化。

items.title: 冰激凌线上与线下销售占比
items.en: online and offline ice cream sales

blocks.v: The pie charts above illustrate the shares of online and offline ice cream sales in China in 2020 and 2021. The online share rose from 5% to 20%, while the offline share fell from 95% to 80%. Although online sales gained 15 percentage points, offline purchases remained dominant.

sents.en: The pie charts above illustrate the shares of online and offline ice cream sales in China in 2020 and 2021.
sents.cn: 以上饼图展示了 2020 年与 2021 年中国冰激凌线上与线下销售的占比。

sents.en: The online share rose from 5% to 20%, while the offline share fell from 95% to 80%.
sents.cn: 线上占比从 5% 升至 20%，而线下占比从 95% 降至 80%。

sents.en: Although online sales gained 15 percentage points, offline purchases remained dominant.
sents.cn: 尽管线上占比提高了 15 个百分点，线下购买仍占主导。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, cold-chain delivery has made it practical to order ice cream to the door. Equally important, people have grown used to buying everyday items on their phones. Beyond that, online promotions and wider choices attract buyers who once shopped only in stores.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: First, cold-chain delivery has made it practical to order ice cream to the door.
sents.cn: 首先，冷链配送让冰激凌送货上门成为现实。

sents.en: Equally important, people have grown used to buying everyday items on their phones.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，人们已经习惯用手机购买日常用品。

sents.en: Beyond that, online promotions and wider choices attract buyers who once shopped only in stores.
sents.cn: 此外，线上促销和更多口味吸引了原本只在实体店购买的顾客。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Platforms should keep the cold chain reliable, or the goods arrive unfit to eat. Stores can turn themselves into places where customers taste before buying. Individuals should order what they will finish rather than stock up on discounts. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Platforms should keep the cold chain reliable, or the goods arrive unfit to eat.
sents.cn: 平台应保证冷链可靠，否则到手的东西根本无法食用。

sents.en: Stores can turn themselves into places where customers taste before buying.
sents.cn: 实体店可以把自己变成能先尝后买的场所。

sents.en: Individuals should order what they will finish rather than stock up on discounts.
sents.cn: 个人应按能吃完的量下单，而不是见折扣就囤。

sents.en: Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
